auth.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 20 letters, digits or underscores.
auth.chooseMethod: How do you want to sign in?
auth.embeddedDesc: We generate a secret phrase on your device. Best for beginners.
auth.externalDesc: Keplr, Leap, Cosmostation, EightSaf or Zunia.
auth.phraseWarn: Write these words on paper, in order. Anyone who has them controls your wallet. We cannot recover them for you, and we never see them.
auth.verifyHelp: Enter the requested words from your phrase.
auth.verifyWrong: That does not match. Check your paper copy.
auth.pinHelp: The PIN locks your wallet on this device (6 digits or more, or a passphrase). It is not a way to recover your phrase.
auth.wrongPin: Wrong PIN. {{left}} tries left before a pause.
auth.vaultWiped: Too many wrong tries: the local wallet was erased. Restore it with your secret phrase.
auth.invalidPhrase: This is not a valid 12 or 24 word phrase.
auth.noAccount: No account yet for this wallet. Choose a username to create one.
auth.haveWallet: I already have a wallet on this device
auth.notInstalled: {{name}} was not detected. Install it, then reload this page.
auth.unsupported: {{name}} does not offer message signing here. Try another wallet.
auth.rejected: You declined the request in your wallet.
auth.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
auth.challenge: The sign-in request expired. Try again.
